items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I remember Edward Clem and Manuel Perez. But I mean, I didn't ever play with them, you know. But I heard them playing.

ctx.x: Well, let's turn it back down. Okay? Go ahead, fine. Play something. Okay. One thing I wanted to ask you about was the different styles of musicians like say the ones that played funerals. Who were some of the favorite trumpet players say in the street? The olden time men back in the times of Manuel Perez and Clem. Edward Clem. Do you remember those fellas?
I remember Edward Clem and Manuel Perez. But I mean, I didn't ever play with them, you know. But I heard them playing. I think Manny Perez and Edward Clem both were real good musicians.
Well, could you give us an impression of the style that say Edward Clem played on your horn?
